notes.title: UI Clarification
notes.content:
[h1]Updated a couple UI elements to improve clarity.[/h1]

[list]
[*] Improved Compass Indicator
[*] Changed colors of HP / Durability / Tower Charging bars
[/list]

notes.title: Feature Complete!
notes.content:
With this patch, all features are now in!  All that's left before full release is some tuning, optimization and bug fixing.  I don't anticipate many bugs at this stage as I've spent a great deal of time hunting them down.

[h2]Weapons / Towers[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added weapon: Electrode.  Mace that holds electrical charge.
[*] Added weapon: Laser.  Speaks for itself.
[*] Added weapon: Laser.  
[*] Cooldown indicators have been added to towers to assist in the zombie assault quests.
[*] The damage of a weapon placed on a [Tower Base] is now reflected in the tower's damage.
[*] Several new traps and trap upgrades have been added.
[/list]

[h2]Misc[/h2]
[list]
[*] Sharper graphics
[*] Damage from constant attack weapons is now applied every frame
[*] Mousing over / clicking on quest items now brings up the item info.
[*] Tutorials messages have been added for Camera Rotation and Crafting
[*] Several skills/items have been added to the rogue-lite menu.
[/list]

[h2]Design Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] TNT will now no longer call a swarm of zombies unless it is used on a vault / safe. 
[*] Each zombie has a specific damage type weakness.
[*] Weapons can now have multiple damage types.  
[*] Severing the limb of a zombie is now chance based.  The more sever damage, the higher the chance.
[*] Quest types can no longer appear consecutively.
[*] Quest 5 is no longer guaranteed to be a zombie assault.
[*] Players damage resistance to towers has been doubled.
[*] Running now occurs only after hitting shift.
[*] Zombie health has been reduced and zombie count has been increase.

[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] All melee weapons now have trails. 
[*] Recipes that have blue crystals in ingredients will now correctly reflect the visuals of blue crystals.
[*] Gather particles should now only show up when it is possible to gather with the current weapon.
[/list]

[h2]Known Bugs / Needs Tweaking[/h2]
[list]
[*] Zombies hearing is a little too good around buildings.  I will likely tweak this so they are less likely to go after the player when they are in a separate room / building.
[*] Sulphate can sometimes appear offset from the crevasse it is associated with.
[*] Build UI needs to update dynamically when returning to it after learning a new recipe.
[*] Build UI needs to update dynamically items in inventory change.
[*] Visual of build should have max durability
[/list]

notes.title: Small Update
notes.content:
A minor patch that fixes a few issues and adds a couple interesting features.

[h2]New Features[/h2]
[list]
[*] Better shadows: Set up a new new system
[*] Updated the controls to auto-target close zombies.  Removed rotation based on the mouse except for building and certain special attacks.
[*] Better [Tower Base] interface for mounted weapon swapping
[*] Better [Jeep] interface for mounted weapon swapping
[*] You can now transform back out of zombie form with reduced CD on next transformation
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] [Tower Base] now will properly accept weapons for tower creation
[*] Removed the ability to spam the zombie transformation
[*] Zombie transformation should be able to hit zombies easier now
[*] Increased weight of zombie transformation so zombies won't be able to push the player around as much.
[/list]

[h2]Known Bugs[/h2]
[list]
[*] When paused, the player can still die.  I'm not sure why this is happening, if anyone runs across it please let me know about the circumstances surrounding it.
[/list]

notes.title: Achievements, Graphics, UI & Zombie Assault Update
notes.content:
The focus of this patch is immersion.  Graphics, UI, and zombie assault missions have all been kicked up a notch and a number of interactable objects and entities have been added/replaced to make the world feel more alive.  

[h2]New Features[/h2]
[list]
[*] Achievements are in and obtainable
[*] Added jeep options in the rogue-like menu.
[*] Watch for the illusive crystal zombie, chase him down for a reward
[/list]

[h2]Assault Missions[/h2]
I primarily want these missions to feel like you've gained a ridiculous amount of power and secondarily want them to require a bit of planning.  With this in mind the systems have been rejigged so they are more focused on the abilities in the zombie form and less focused on follower zombies.
[list]
[*] Added upgradable and very powerful charged attack that can have a very large reach
[*] Added upgradable 'harden' ability, which drastically reduces damage taken for a short time
[*] Zombies should no longer spawn during assault quests
[*] Non-player zombies are now hostile to player even in transformed state
[*] Player zombies can no longer be damaged by the player
[*] Player zombies disappear after cooldown has reset
[/list]

[h2]Ease Of Use[/h2]
[list]
[*] Various keyboard layout changes
[*] Added keyless move button
[*] Added belt selection system controlled via mouse wheel
[*] Added info text and warning tutorial features
[*] Added key/button indicators
[*] Combined first and second part of Break & Enter missions for smoother progression
[*] Objects can no longer be hit unless fully selected.  This is not true for entities.
[*] Wave based missions should end when all zombies are dead, not just when time expires
[*] Most item descriptions should show where to find more of it
[/list]

[h2]Polish[/h2]
[list]
[*] Most animations are smoother and faster
[*] Revamped the UI, removed a number of items from the HUD
[*] Iron 'rocks' have been removed, replaced with various iron sources (Hub caps, bikes, etc)
[*] Copper 'rocks' have been removed, replaced with power poles
[/list]

[h2]Zombie Mechanics[/h2]
[list]
[*] Zombies now spawn more regularly
[*] Zombie hearing range has been drastically reduced
[*] Zombies now wander around
[*] Zombies now explode, rather than fall over
[*] Critter and zombie wander pathing has been updated
[*] The number of zombies in an area (between quests) has now been limited to encourage progression
[/list]

[h2]Miscellaneous Mechanics[/h2]
[list]
[*] When an item breaks, it now will automatically be salvaged
[*] Vault (hop over object) was added back into the game
[*] Both vaulting an jumping are now preformed automatically when running into objects that support the respective action.
[*] Heat vents no longer cause damage to the player or zombies
[/list]

notes.title: Combat Update
notes.content:
This update focuses primarily on the combat system.  New weapons, weapon tuning and skills as well as more combat options

[h2]Combat[/h2]
Each weapon now has both a regular attack and a charged attack.  
[list]
[*] For melee this adds a more powerful attack option at the expense of some extra time.
[*] For ranged weapons, the charged attack is the only way to fire at range.  The regular attack is a melee attack that can be used with the weapon equipped.  The attack damage for this is based on your [Stun] skill as the unarmed tree has been moved.  See below for details
[/list]

[h2]Weapons[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added Weapons
[list]
[*]  a.[b] Buzz Saw[/b]: A melee weapon that runs on syngas.  It attacks quickly and constantly and can even harvest resources.  It has some ability to sever limbs and will benefit some from a few of the [Sever] skills.
[*]  b. [b]Bat (Wood / Metal)[/b]: A melee weapon that has a reasonable range and can stun zombies.  Ideal for attacking the hardened Hulk-Zombie.
[/list]
[*] Weapons have now been separated into type with each type having its own benefits.
[list]
[*] a.	[b]Sever weapons[/b] (Axes and other bladed weapons) have an increased ability to remove limbs from zombies.  When a limb is removed extra crystals will drop and the zombie will be unable to use that limb.  The sever-damage increases with power attacks.
[*] b.	[b]Stun weapons[/b] (Bats/Fists) have a better chance to stun a zombie, disabling it for a period of time relative to the zombies remaining health (lower health gives longer stun).  If an attack that would stun a zombie is also a critical hit then the zombie is also knocked down.
[*] c.	[b]Pierce weapons[/b] (Pickaxe) now are ideal to take out armored zombies, including the shield zombies.  One point of piercing grants an additional minimum amount of damage to any attack with that weapon.
[*] d.	[b]Ranged weapons[/b] (Bows / Guns) have the advantage of not requiring close to close combat with zombies and a lower stamina use on attack.  They also have a high critical hit chance and boast significant damage.
[*] e.	[b]Mechanical weapons[/b] (Flame Thrower / Buzz Saw) posses the potential for great area of effect and fast damage.  They also have unique benefits associated with their size, such as extra armor.
[/list]
[*] Modifiers now provide a significant upgrade to any weapon they are added to.  At the start of the game only one modifier will be able to be attached to any weapon created.
[*] Cannon weapon fire will now affect enemies around the target as well.
[*] Weapons now have a noise value, the louder the weapon the more attention it will draw.
[/list]

[h2]Skills[/h2]
[list]
[*] 1) A new set of skills has been added (Sever, Stun, Pierce, Ranged, and Mechanical) to allow for specialization into each weapon type.
[*] 2) A new crafting skill has been added for modifications; allowing for more than one modification on a crafted item.
[*] 3) While searching you are more likely to find low level items with mods than you are to find higher level items.  
[*] 4) The crystal drop skill will now make zombies physically drop more crystals to pick up.
[/list]

[h2]Itemization[/h2]
[list]
[*] Syngas is now found in significantly higher abundance.
[*] Some of the larger bunkers had a lot of loot and not a lot of difficulty.  More zombies and traps have been added in an attempt to balance this.
[/list]

[h2]Zombies[/h2]
[list]
[*] The standard zombie and shield zombie now have unique attack specials
[*] Health and damage reduction have been adjusted relative to the new weapon values
[*] Spawn rates have been adjusted to make things easier, especially in early game
[/list]

[h2]Quality of Life[/h2]
[list]
[*] Build menu will now remember the last item selected if possible
[*] Durability now shows on weapon on PC version
[*] Camera can now be rotated while building without canceling the build
[*] Chicken coop should sound off less often
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes / Polish[/h2]
[list]
[*] Loot all now only closes the menu if everything was looted
[*] The load screen should now show up instead of a black screen (More noticeable on Mobile)
[*] Now when switching out from one weapon to another weapon of the same type the equip animation will play
[*] Metal spikes are no longer available at the start of the game
[*] The camera should no longer be too close or too far from the ground at the start of the game.
[*] A number of buffs on clothing and armor now display correctly
[*] Know recipes should no longer be chosen when a recipe is found
[*] Flamethrower turrets will no longer activate if the player is crouched in their attack zone
[*] Flamethrower particles should now activate correctly when turned on and off quickly
[*] Zombies should no longer be able to be hit after they have died
[*] Various UI menus have been updated to allow for better flow
[/list]

notes.title: Early Access V.1.3.11
notes.content:
Here's a quick look a number of the changes in this patch:

[b]Crystals[/b] may be refunded as skills may have changed.

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[b]Missing Fire Workstations[/b]
Are now visible again

[b]Spike Trap Navigation[/b]
It was difficult to get around spike traps in some situations (Getting caught between the spikes and a wall).  It should now be substantially easier for the player to move past them.


[h2]Balancing[/h2]
[b]Large Bunkers[/b]
They are a treasure trove of goodies, so it made sense to make them a little more difficult.  Zombies should be more frequent within them.

[b]Damage Reduction (Zombies)[/b]
Previously DR was linearly based for both the player and zombies.  The player had already been switched over to be percent based, the zombies are now using the same system.

[b]Zombie Frequency[/b]
Zombies were fairly persistent at the start of the game, perhaps too much so.  I've made some changes that should make them less interested in the player during the first stages of the game.
